note: The executable form of the router rule (brief 102, Contract, Router). Rules apply in this order: high (a clause opens with a HIGH_VERBS word, or the prompt is over 600 characters); low (the prompt opens with a LOW_CUES cue, is at most 200 characters and holds no HIGH_VERBS word anywhere); a follow-up of at most 40 characters keeps priorTier; mid otherwise. padTo pads the prompt with filler to exactly that many characters.
